components.label: Mixer body
components.purpose: Four-channel club mixer, 407.4 wide × 458.3 deep × 107.9 high mm. Seed records 140.7 mm high with the Bluetooth antenna up and 10.2 kg.
components.limits: Envelope from the product page; weight and antenna height are retailer-reproduced.

components.label: Channels 1–4
components.purpose: Four channel strips: input selector, trim, 3-band EQ, colour FX knob, cue, 60 mm fader. 32-bit ESS A/D on every input.

components.label: Crossfader and master section
components.purpose: Crossfader with curve and assign, master level, booth level with 2-band booth EQ, and two independent headphone outputs.

components.label: Beat FX and sound colour FX
components.purpose: Beat FX section with display and the X-Pad, plus sound colour FX selected across channels.
components.limits: Effect list and layout are approximate.

components.label: MASTER OUT 1 (XLR) and 2 (RCA)
components.purpose: Balanced XLR master pair and an unbalanced RCA master pair, 32-bit ESS D/A. The XLR pair is the one for the amplifier or powered subs.
components.limits: Connector types are the standard DJM layout reproduced by the seed; the manual page was not machine-read.

components.label: BOOTH OUT · TRS
components.purpose: Balanced 1/4-inch TRS booth pair with its own level and 2-band EQ on the top panel.

components.label: LINE / PHONO inputs · RCA
components.purpose: RCA pairs for each channel, switchable line/phono on the turntable channels, with a signal ground post.
components.limits: Pair count per channel not machine-read from the manual.

components.label: DIGITAL IN · coaxial
components.purpose: Coaxial digital inputs for CDJ digital outputs, keeping the player-to-mixer path in the digital domain.
components.limits: Count not machine-read from the manual.

components.label: MIC 1 (XLR/TRS combo, phantom) and MIC 2 (TRS)
components.purpose: MIC 1 is a combo jack with switchable phantom power for a condenser microphone; MIC 2 is a 1/4-inch jack. Mic talkover and feedback reducer live on the top panel.

components.label: USB · 1 × type A, 2 × type B/C
components.purpose: Type A port for a stick or recording; two computer ports (type B and type C) so two laptops can connect at once.
components.limits: The feature text and spec table disagree on the B/C count.

components.label: LINK ports · Pro DJ Link hub
components.purpose: Ethernet LINK ports that act as the Pro DJ Link hub for the CDJ-3000s and a rekordbox laptop.
components.limits: Port count not machine-read from the manual.

components.label: MULTI I/O · send/return
components.purpose: Send/return with an independent channel selector so an external effect unit or a tablet effect app can be inserted.

components.label: Bluetooth / Wi-Fi antenna
components.purpose: Rear antenna for the Bluetooth input (routable to any channel) and built-in Wi-Fi for Stagehand and link features. Folds up to the 140.7 mm height the seed records.

components.label: AC IN · lockable power cord
components.purpose: IEC inlet with a lockable cord in most regions, and the power switch.

page.practice_cards:
Simulated DJM-A9 state



Connections and controls
Each button only reads back what the manufacturer document says that connector or control does.


Mic into the A9
The SM58 goes into MIC 1 or MIC 2 on XLR. Leave phantom power off for a dynamic mic; it is only there for condensers on MIC 1.
Talkover and feedback reducer are top-panel functions, not simulated here.
